queries: Microsoft 365 Copilot August 2025 8 million active licensed users independent

sources_considered.why: Read successfully. The article explicitly attributes the eight-million claim to Zitron and supplies no independent confirmation.
Primary disclosure illustrates why a much larger all-Copilot active-user figure cannot settle this narrower claim.
Primary later disclosure reports paid seats, not August active licensed users.
Search surfaced an aggregate statistics page repeating the August estimate, but no independent underlying August record was established.

evidence_items.locator: Satya Nadella prepared remarks, app-layer discussion
evidence_items.explanation: This covers multiple Copilot applications and both commercial and consumer users. It neither confirms nor contradicts the August count for active licensed Microsoft 365 Copilot users.

evidence_items.locator: Satya Nadella prepared remarks, Microsoft 365 Copilot seat growth
evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft disclosed paid seats at a later date. Neither the time period nor the activity definition matches the claim, so this is context only.

unresolved_gaps: No independently confirmed August 2025 active licensed-user count was found.
No matched August subscriber denominator was established.
Reports repeating the eight-million figure were not independent corroboration.
